enrichment.summary: The district will train and coach staff at the Alameda County Office of Education and other Alameda County school districts that serve immigrant and newcomer students and families. The agreement runs July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, with an amount not to exceed $300,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Alameda County Office of Education Services Agreement - Immigrant and Newcomer Support - English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement (ELLMA)

enrichment.headline: Adds $71,000 and a year to Restoration Management's environmental clean-up contract, to $170,000
enrichment.summary: The district is adding $71,000 to its contract with Restoration Management Company for environmental clean-up work that reduces risk at school sites, raising the cap from $99,000 to $170,000. The term is extended from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

vendor.name: Jon K Takata Corporation dba Restoration Management Company

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Extends Claremont Partners' health benefits communications contract a year at $36,000 per year
enrichment.summary: The district is extending, by one year to June 30, 2027, its agreement with Claremont Partners for employee health benefits communications and secretarial support to the labor-management Health Benefits Governance Board. The yearly cost stays at $36,000 and the services are unchanged.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement - Claremont Partners, Inc. - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Pays $4.32M for excess property and liability coverage and $888,000 for excess workers' compensation
enrichment.summary: The district will pay $888,000 to the PRISM joint powers authority for excess workers' compensation coverage for fiscal year 2026-27. It will also pay $4,318,365 to the Northern California ReLiEF joint powers authority, through broker Keenan & Associates, for excess property and liability coverage from July 1, 2026 to July 1, 2027.

vendor.name: Northern California ReLiEF (administered by Keenan & Associates)

outcome.action: Adopted

items.title: Excess Workers’ Compensation Coverage and Excess Property and Liability Coverage - Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2026-2027 - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Hires George Hills Company for liability and property claims adjusting, up to $400,000 per year
enrichment.summary: George Hills Company, a third party administrator (TPA), will handle the district's liability and property claims for up to $400,000 per fiscal year, with a 3% annual increase. The term runs June 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, with one-year renewals possible. The text says the board is rejecting all other bids. A data sharing agreement covers the same term.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Claims Adjusting and Administrative Services Contract, Subrogation Agreement and Data Sharing Agreement - George Hills Company - General Counsel

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $39,700 for the Epicenter platform to track charter school oversight data
enrichment.summary: The Institute for Excellence In Education will provide the Epicenter software platform, with setup and technical support, so the Office of Charter Schools can track data and documents on charter governance, admissions, finances, enrollment, attendance and teacher credentials. The term is July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

vendor.name: The Institute for Excellence In Education

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement - The Institute for Excellence In Education - Charter Schools Office

enrichment.headline: Pays Centurisk up to $249,500 to verify the district's machinery and equipment inventory
enrichment.summary: Centurisk will inspect school and district sites and verify the inventory of machinery and equipment that cost $500 or more. This supports accountability for assets, financial reporting rules and the outside audit. The service period began April 10, 2026, before board approval, and runs through June 30, 2027.

enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying the written minutes of its regular meeting held June 3, 2026, prepared by staff shortly after the meeting.
